description: This file implements the authentication backend schema for etcd, including functions for creating buckets, reading and writing auth enabled status and revision, and managing transactions.

classes.name: authBackend
classes.description: Implements the auth.AuthBackend interface, manages auth state and buckets.

classes.name: authReadTx
classes.description: Represents a read transaction for auth data.

classes.name: authBatchTx
classes.description: Represents a batch transaction for auth data, allowing modifications and commits.

methods.name: NewAuthBackend
methods.description: Creates a new instance of authBackend with provided logger and backend.

methods.name: CreateAuthBuckets
methods.description: Creates necessary buckets for auth data.

methods.name: ForceCommit
methods.description: Forces commit of the backend transaction.

methods.name: ReadTx
methods.description: Returns a read transaction for auth data.

methods.name: BatchTx
methods.description: Returns a batch transaction for auth data.

methods.name: Unlock
methods.description: Unlocks and commits the batch transaction.

methods.name: UnsafeReadAuthEnabled
methods.description: Reads auth enabled status from a read transaction.

methods.name: UnsafeReadAuthRevision
methods.description: Reads auth revision from a read transaction.

methods.name: RLock
methods.description: Acquires a read lock on the transaction.

methods.name: RUnlock
methods.description: Releases the read lock on the transaction.
